# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m154 engine update**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 while retaining the recent GPU and readback improvements. This cumulative release includes Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and managed lifetime corrections. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback should review the changed font selection behavior.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback can select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change text metrics or glyphs. Specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic font selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia advanced through m152, m153, and m154** — Updates the bundled rendering engine with the m152 release and servicing fixes, the m153 stability updates, and the m154 engine update. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can target Skia's newer GPU rendering architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel retrieval. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET package added** — Provides a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for applications using Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel source lifetime issues corrected** — Prevents native use-after-free errors when iterating SKRegion spans or creating SKPixmap subsets and derived pixmaps. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster and runtime-effect resources released correctly** — Fixes an allocation leak after failed raster image creation and releases the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support improved** — Uses FreeType to make font support available on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Apple native symbols packaged** — Generates native symbol packages for Apple platforms during packaging to improve native crash diagnostics. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Improves HarfBuzz packaging and shaping efficiency, and fixes the lifetime of stream-backed blobs.
